# Agent Lifecycle Kit

> Ship AI agents you can prove. Eval-Driven Development (EDD) is the sensible default for tool-using agents—plus lifecycle governance across Cursor, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Windsurf, and GitHub Copilot.

## Core value
- **Eval-Driven Development (EDD):** TDD for agents—YAML suites, JSONL datasets, mocked MCP tools, schema/routing asserts, LLM-as-a-judge, CI gates, prod→JSONL
- Architecture: Hexagonal, DDD, vertical slices, clean code
- Lifecycle skills, language/framework profiles, MCP catalog
- CLI: `kit eval run|watch|report|ci` (alias `agent-kit`); `kit init`, `kit audit`
